svg.title: Every lit square is a day I shipped: 57 of the last 90 days, 350 contributions. Lead developer at Flexiestays in Bournemouth since January 2025: the website, the Flutter app, the dashboards and Foxie. Also building Aisbar, a shift-handover tool for ICU doctors in Brazil.
